description: MainActivity.java for an Android app, serving as a launcher activity that manages a fragment, logging, and menu options.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that initializes UI, manages a fragment, and handles logging and menu interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and adds ScreenCaptureFragment if no saved state.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu, toggles log visibility and title based on mLogShown.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, toggles log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with LogWrapper, MessageOnlyLogFilter, and LogFragment.
